title: FRBR URI Jurisdiction Profile
description: Schema for defining an AKN FRBR URI profile for a Swiss jurisdiction (federal, cantonal, or municipal). Communities can create their own profiles by following this schema.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable comment about this profile

jurisdiction.description: Unique jurisdiction identifier. Use ISO 3166-2 style: 'ch' for federal, 'ch-zh' for canton, 'ch-zh-261' for municipality (canton code + BFS number)

name.description: Full official name of the jurisdiction

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 canton abbreviation (e.g. 'ZH', 'ZG', 'BE', 'VD'). Omit for federal.

municipality.description: Official municipality name. Only for level=municipality.

bfs_number.description: Swiss Federal Statistical Office (BFS/OFS) municipality number. Used as unique identifier in URIs for municipalities.

base_uri.description: Base URI of the jurisdiction's ELI/legal information system

akn_country.description: AKN country code component (always 'ch' for Switzerland)

akn_prefix.description: AKN URI prefix for this jurisdiction

language_codes.description: Mapping from 2-letter ISO 639-1 language codes to 3-letter ISO 639-2 codes used in AKN URIs

default_language.description: Default language code (2-letter) for this jurisdiction

document_types.description: Map of document type keys to their AKN metadata. Add new document types specific to your jurisdiction as needed.

subtype.description: Jurisdiction-specific subtype identifier (lowercase, no spaces). Used in URI construction.

numbering.description: Jurisdiction-specific numbering system metadata (e.g. SR prefix for federal, LS for ZH, GS for ZG, BFS number for municipalities)

uri_templates.description: FRBR URI templates for the four FRBR levels. Use placeholders: {doc_type}, {date} (YYYY-MM-DD), {number}, {lang} (3-letter), {version} (date or 'current'), {format} (xml, html, pdf), {component}

examples._comment: Example: Gemeinde Cham – a community adding their own profile
